blogs.name: SwiftPOS Blog
blogs.verificationMethod: SwiftPOS itself confirmed real — a Nigerian POS/inventory software company with genuinely detailed, current (2026-dated) guides specifically for provision store and mini-mart owners: full startup-cost breakdowns by budget tier, real margin data (8-40% depending on product category), and operational advice beyond just 'is there foot traffic'. Feed URL uses the standard WordPress pattern — a direct RSS search got confused with 'Swift' the Apple programming language instead of the company, so this wasn't confirmed as cleanly as most entries this session. Worth a direct check before shipping.

notes: Same shape as POS/Agent Banking: no dedicated YouTube channel exists for the business side of running a provision store — TikTok has extensive shop-tour and 'how much to start' content, but nothing structured as ongoing business education. Content lives in article form across several real Nigerian sources beyond SwiftPOS.
